use_case: Customer-service chatbot with account access (web and app chat): answers billing, outage, and plan questions and takes allow-listed account actions through the API gateway
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (SaaS on a large language model platform)
build_or_buy: Buy (configured with knowledge articles and an allow-listed API client)
data_categories: Customer messages; account data including CPNI (call detail, voice plan, bills); chat transcripts
consequential_decision_category: None (credits, deposits, disconnections, and authentication changes stay with agents)
human_in_the_loop: Account changes need customer confirmation; agents handle credits, disputes, and any authentication change; customers can reach a person at any time
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2010(c), (e), (f) and 64.2007(b) (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01); 64.2011 for any unauthorized disclosure; FTC Act Sec. 5 for broadband claims (counsel view); state breach laws
status: In production (about 1.1 million sessions per month); account recovery feature disabled 2026-08-07; continue with conditions

use_case: AI voice agent in the IVR answering outage and billing questions
vendor_or_model: Same chatbot vendor (speech recognition and synthesis)
data_categories: Caller audio; transcripts; account summary after keypad PIN entry
human_in_the_loop: Never discloses call detail; transfers to an agent for any account change; caller can say 'agent' at any time
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2010(b) (call detail by telephone only with a password); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example)
status: Pilot since 2026-05-11 in 2 states; expansion paused

use_case: Residential deposit decision model: combines a consumer report score with account history to decide whether a new customer must pay a deposit
data_categories: Consumer report data; prior account history; service address; date of birth
human_in_the_loop: Agents can waive a deposit; customers can ask for review; model does not deny service
applicable_laws: FCRA adverse action notice (15 U.S.C. 1681a(k)(1)(B)(iv); 1681m(a)); FTC Act Sec. 5 (counsel view on non-common-carrier activities); state utility deposit rules where they apply (generic)
status: In production (about 14% of new orders get a deposit); online and chat orders missing adverse action notices

use_case: Network anomaly detection and predictive maintenance for the NOC (flags failing optics, power, and traffic anomalies)
vendor_or_model: Service assurance platform vendor's machine learning module
data_categories: Network telemetry and alarms (no customer identity)
human_in_the_loop: Recommendations only; automated configuration changes disabled; NOC engineers decide
applicable_laws: 47 CFR Part 4 (outage detection and reporting stay with the NOC); POL-03 4.3

use_case: Generative design assistant that drafts fiber route and splice designs for engineers
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant with design plug-in (no-training terms)
data_categories: Customer network designs and GIS data (Confidential); no FCI permitted
human_in_the_loop: A professional engineer reviews and seals every design
applicable_laws: Customer contracts (confidentiality); POL-04 4.6 and 4.10 (no FCI or Restricted data)

use_case: MNO alarm correlation and automated ticket triage for 64 customers' networks
vendor_or_model: Service assurance platform vendor's correlation module (MNO tenant)
data_categories: Customer network alarms and tickets (some with subscriber names and addresses)
human_in_the_loop: Operators see every suppressed alarm in a queue; alarms tagged 911 or special facility must never be auto-closed
applicable_laws: MNO customer contracts (30-minute outage notice); SOC 2 commitments in preparation (P09); customers' own 47 CFR 4.9 duties

use_case: Inspection imagery analysis that flags structural and lighting defects in drone photos of towers
human_in_the_loop: A structural engineer reviews every flagged image and a sample of unflagged images
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 17.47-17.48 (lighting defects still require inspection and FAA reporting duties); tenant lease terms
status: Pilot on 800 towers; started before registration (division-supplements.md section 4)

use_case: Lease abstraction: generative AI extracts rent, escalation, and renewal terms from ground leases
data_categories: Ground leases with landowner names, addresses, and payment terms; taxpayer IDs and bank data excluded by redaction
human_in_the_loop: Lease administrators verify every extracted term before it enters SYS-T1
applicable_laws: FTC Act Sec. 5 (N53-R02); state breach laws if landowner data leaks; POL-04 4.10

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting, summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant with no-training and limited-retention terms
data_categories: Internal documents; Restricted data (CPNI, lawful-intercept information, FCI) prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for customer authentication, CPNI, or regulatory filings

use_case: Coding assistant for digital channels and OSS developers
data_categories: Source code; no customer data permitted
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review all suggestions; normal code review and pipeline tests apply
